values.en: Argument. Necessity follows from equality of related classes. For sufficiency define g([x]ₛ)=f(x); compatibility makes the value independent of the representative. Since every quotient element has a representative, this also proves uniqueness.
values.zh-CN: 论证。必要性来自相关代表的商类相等；充分性按 g([x]ₛ)=f(x) 定义，相容条件保证取值不依赖代表。每个商元素都有代表，故这样的映射唯一。
